subject: SIG initiation: prefill ownership, SOC 2 status, and HIPAA scope
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@medalign.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG initiation: prefill ownership, SOC 2 status, and HIPAA scope

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + three asks so we can kick the SIG/CAIQ prefill: 

Recap: 
- You want to move forward with Redwood for inference (hosts in us-central) and need our security intake for procurement.
- Primary compliance points you raised: SOC 2 evidence, HIPAA BAA requirements for PHI use case, and data residency in US-only.

Asks / clarifying questions: 
1) SOC 2: Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report available (latest period + auditor name)? If Type I only, what is the planned Type II completion window?
2) HIPAA: Will MedAlign require Redwood to sign a BAA, or will you accept our standard BAA template? Any specific encryption/segmentation controls you need called out?
3) SIG vs CAIQ: From your side, are you planning to send a vendor SIG (SIG Lite/Full) or would a CAIQ prefill be acceptable to accelerate things?
4) Evidence mapping: if you have a short list of must-have evidence (e.g., SOC 2 section, pen test report, encryption config, KMS attestations), please list them so we can prioritize.
5) Owner: who on your security/procurement side should we loop in for uploads/DocuSign?

I've attached a quick prefill template (MedAlign_SIG_Prefill.xlsx) and a network diagram you shared during the demo for reference. If you confirm SOC 2/BAA expectations and the preferred questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ), we'll propose a 7–10 day plan to deliver the prefill + evidence map.

Next steps we propose from Redwood: 
- Redwood to prefill CAIQ where possible and mark items needing customer input.
- Security to triage required evidence and flag any gaps that need remediation or exceptions.

Thanks — I can take point on the prefill.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security & Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MedAlign_SIG_Prefill.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: Network_Diagram.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@medalign.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medalign.com>
Date: 2025-08-03T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation: prefill ownership, SOC 2 status, and HIPAA scope

Soojin — thanks for the clear recap. Answers inline below: 

1) SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2024-09 through 2025-03) — auditor: Harborpoint LLP. I pasted the redacted report link in the drive we discussed (see link).
2) HIPAA: MedAlign requires a signed BAA for any PHI; we can start with Redwood's standard BAA. Encryption at rest (AES-256) and TLS 1.2+ in transit are required; we also ask for KMS key separation for customer data — if you have an attestation or KMS diagram that helps.
3) SIG vs CAIQ: Procurement prefers a CAIQ prefill to speed things up and then we might ask a short SIG-lite follow-up for anything not covered. CAIQ works for us.
4) Evidence: must-haves: SOC 2 report, latest pen test summary, KMS diagram/attestation, data deletion policy, and vulnerability management cadence.
5) Owner: looping Priya Shah (cc) — she owns vendor intake and DocuSign.

We'd like the prefill in the next 10 business days if possible. Let me know if you need anything else.

— Alex
Alex Morgan
Security Lead, MedAlign
[Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=abcd1234]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-04T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation: prefill ownership, SOC 2 status, and HIPAA scope

Putting a quick note from the commercial side — thanks for driving this. A few operational items: 

- Timeline: 7–10 business days for a CAIQ prefill + evidence map is feasible. If they need a SIG-lite follow-up, add 3–5 days depending on evidence turnaround.
- Pricing: MedAlign is in advanced POC; we should be prepared for an enterprise BAA + annualized committed usage discussion. I'll hold off on discounts until we have procurement/BAA confirmation.
- Security asks: Soojin — can you prioritize the following in the prefill: KMS key ownership (who manages keys), network segmentation for inference workload, and the pen test executive summary? Those items typically unlock procurement approvals.

I'll be available to join a call with Priya next week if helpful.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@medalign.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medalign.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-05T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG initiation: prefill ownership, SOC 2 status, and HIPAA scope

Alex / Priya — great, thanks for the quick answers and the SOC 2 link. Confirming next steps and owners: 

1) Redwood (So on behalf of Security) will prefill the CAIQ using the attached template and mark fields that need MedAlign input. Deliverable: MedAlign_SIG_Prefill.xlsx + evidence map. Target: 2025-08-15 (10 business days).
2) Ben will coordinate procurement pricing/BAA parallel track with Priya.
3) Action items for MedAlign (Priya/Alex): share redacted SOC 2 report link (done), share pen-test exec summary and KMS diagram/attestation where possible, and confirm any additional controls that must be called out in the BAA.

I've attached Redwood_SIG_Guidance_v1.pdf with a short explanation of how we map CAIQ sections to our evidence buckets. If anything changes on timeline we will flag immediately.

Thanks — I'll send the first draft of the CAIQ prefill by Friday and loop you for gaps.

— Soojin
